survival_report.system_diagnosis: Bot is mechanically healthy (PID 3032, cycle 20, fresh heartbeat 00:01 EDT, SOL bal 1.1377). But active strategies have produced ZERO new buys in 4+ days — last buy WORLDCUP CB on May 13 22:44 EDT, last sell WORLDCUP stop on May 13 23:35 EDT. The bot is actively scanning (live events show wallet-sell signals from 8+ tracked wallets and a steady stream of m5-pump/m5-dump/downtrend skips on real candidates), but the universal filter stack is rejecting everything upstream. The H11 gate that activated sometime between May 14-17 has not been exercised on a single fresh_profile/fresh_boost buy yet, so we still cannot tell whether it's helping or hurting. Run-283 used a stale May-11 backup and missed two losses (ANDV bs EMERGENCY -30.6%, WORLDCUP cb stop -10.5%) — those got absorbed this run, refreshing bear_strength from 24T 45.8% WR to 28T 39.3% WR.
survival_report.exit_analysis: 7d rolling (4 trades, all stop-losses): avg_loss -15.84%, R/R 0.0 (no wins), stop_loss_rate 100%, pnl -0.0070 SOL. All-time (1003 sells): WR 35.4%, avg_win +13.17%, avg_loss -16.57%, R/R 0.79, stop_loss_rate 50.6%, profit_factor 0.43, pnl -1.172 SOL. Exit mix all-time: stop_loss 42.6%, time_exit 22.4%, target 14.6%, other 12.4%, trailing 8.1%. ANDV's -30.56% emergency stop on May 12 is the standout 7d disaster — 3x the typical -10% BS stop.
survival_report.strategy_work: No hypothesis advanced via code this run. Filed REQ-017 to research brain asking for an ANDV bear_strength post-mortem (entry-feature comparison vs GAYTES, price-path forensics, single-axis filter proposal). Re-examined bear_strength PAUSE eligibility: all four fast-kill criteria at lifetime N=28 PASS (R/R 2.09, WR 39.3%, pnl +0.0083 SOL, remove-ANDV-outlier still positive +0.0118). DO NOT PAUSE BS. But flagged next BS fire as a watched trade — a 3rd consecutive loss would re-open the PAUSE conversation regardless of fast-kill arithmetic.

changelog: Refreshed the bot's running tally of trade results from the live stats file. Two losses that the previous brain run missed because it used an old backup file are now properly counted: a bad ANDV trade on May 12 that lost 30.6% (the worst single bear_strength loss ever), and a WORLDCUP loss on May 13 of 10.5%.

The bear_strength strategy's lifetime numbers got worse with those two losses added: win rate dropped from 45.8% to 39.3%, average risk/reward ratio dropped from 2.18 to 2.09, total profit dropped from 0.0159 SOL to 0.0083 SOL. Strategy is still profitable overall — well above the pause threshold — but the next loss would put it on watch.

The consensus_boost strategy's lifetime stats got a similar refresh: 46 trades now (was 38), win rate 45.7% (was 50%), risk/reward 0.99 (was 1.68), small loss of 0.0018 SOL overall (was a small profit). Still above the kill threshold but the profitability has eroded.
Added a brand-new entry for fresh_boost (22 trades, 40.9% win rate, 0.80 risk/reward, lost 0.0259 SOL total) — this strategy was not tracked in the active list at all before this run.

Asked the research brain to do a detailed post-mortem on the catastrophic ANDV trade: what made it look like a good entry, what went wrong, and propose one simple filter that would have caught it without also blocking the GAYTES winner from 2 days earlier.

Updated the brain's notes on H11 (the new 6-hour minimum age gate for fresh strategies) to reflect that we still haven't seen it block or pass a single trade — the bot has been trade-dormant for 4 days, so there's nothing to measure yet.
Bumped the brain version number from 288 to 289.

Wrote a high-priority research request asking for a detailed look at the ANDV emergency stop loss.
Confirmed the bot itself is healthy — actively scanning new tokens and correctly filtering them out — but is not finding any candidates that pass the full filter stack right now.
Did not change any code this run. Used the wakeup time to fix the data picture and queue research.
next_priorities: Wait for research brain to deliver findings on REQ-016 (silence-window context) and REQ-017 (ANDV post-mortem). If REQ-017 returns a clean single-axis filter that blocks ANDV without blocking GAYTES, that's the next code ship candidate (~5-10 LOC).

If 24+ hours pass with zero buys (currently 97h dormant), file a new research request asking why fresh_profile/fresh_boost are producing zero candidates that pass H11 (whether the gate is too tight or whether upstream filters are catching everything first).
Watch for next bear_strength fire — third consecutive BS loss would re-open the PAUSE conversation regardless of fast-kill arithmetic.

Consider whether the consensus_boost R/R drop from 1.68 to 0.99 across the recent 8-trade absorption warrants its own audit ask to research brain (probably premature — wait until next CB fire to add datapoint).
